ideal: Alert: Meta fell 6.98% while the S&P 500 fell 1.18%, on the same day it filed its 10-Q quarterly report (link). Berkshire rose 1.48% while the S&P 500 fell 1.18%, and no filing explains it yet. Tesla filed its 10-Q quarterly report (link).

verdicts.note: Covers all four events with correct numbers and links, but it says no filing explains Meta's drop while listing Meta's same-day 10-Q right below, which contradicts itself.
verdicts.answer:
Meta Platforms fell 6.98% (S&P 500 fell 1.18%); no filing explains it yet  
Berkshire Hathaway rose 1.48% while the S&P 500 fell 1.18% — no filing explains it yet  
Meta Platforms 10-Q quarterly report: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1326801/000162828026066773/meta-20260930.htm  
Tesla 10-Q quarterly report: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1318605/000162828026066775/tsla-20260930.htm

verdicts.note: Leaves out Berkshire's move and Tesla's 10-Q, gives no link, and contradicts itself by saying a 10-Q was filed yet no filing explains the drop.
verdicts.answer: Meta Platforms fell 6.98% while S&P 500 fell 1.18%. 10-Q filed. no filing explains it yet.

verdicts.note: Covers everything with links and correctly ties Meta's drop to its same-day 10-Q, but the wording ('earnings-lagging', 'current-quarter') is jargony and slightly off.
verdicts.answer:
